messages:
Maria L: Heads up — multiple customers reporting SAML login failures since ~2026-02-14 22:10 UTC. Errors in prod: ConditionsNotSatisfied and SignatureVerificationFailed.
Ashwin R: Confirmed in us-west-2. Logs show 'conditions_not_satisfied' and intermittent 'signature_verification_failed'. I also pulled IdP health metrics — a subset of IdP nodes show ~+6m clock drift.
Maria L: Could this be tied to the recent signing-key rollover? Any KMS/HSM rotations on our side overnight? @Kevin P
Kevin P: No scheduled KMS rotations from our side. Quick check: our metadata snapshot (s3://redwood-idp-metadata/metadata.xml) currently references SigningKeyId 'rk-2025-12'. IdP metadata shows kid=IDP-k-042. There was a key rotation on the IdP yesterday and some nodes may not have the latest metadata.
SecurityEng - Nora: Audit logs show a surge of SCIM deprovision attempts at 22:09 that returned 429 rate-limit responses. The timing lines up with the SAML spike — could be a thundering herd during nightly provisioning/deprovisioning.
sre-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0143 created and assigned to eng-security.
Ashwin R: Short-term mitigation: increasing allow_clock_skew_seconds to 300 in our SAML validator reduces 'ConditionsNotSatisfied' hits. Also adding a temporary kid-fallback for ~5m to accept the old kid while we reconcile metadata. Rolling a canary to prod now.
Kevin P: For KMS sanity: check key aliases in Vault and our metadata. Example: `vault list secret/idp-keys` then `vault read secret/idp-keys/rk-2025-12`. If our SigningKeyId != IdP's active key, signature validation will fail on the mismatched nodes.
Maria L: On SCIM: some deprovisioned users lost RBAC entitlements because the PATCH requests failed mid-sync. We need a backfill to reapply roles from the audit logs.
Kevin P: I'll prepare a small backfill + retryer. Important points: handle 429 with exponential backoff, idempotency for PATCH/DELETE, and batch sizing to avoid new rate limits.
Kevin P: ```bash
# naive retry example (replace with robust client)
for uid in $(cat users_to_backfill.txt); do
  attempt=0
  until [ $attempt -ge 5 ]; do
    curl -s -X PATCH 'https://api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users/'"$uid" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d @patch.json && break
    attempt=$((attempt+1))
    sleep $((2**attempt))
  done
done
```
Maria L: Good. Also add an audit marker when we reapply roles so we can trace changes: log entries should include original_event_ts, actor, and delta.
SecurityEng - Nora: Action items: 1) Ashwin to push clock-skew canary and kid-fallback (done in 10m). 2) Kevin to run key-vault verification and share diff vs IdP metadata. 3) Kevin to prepare SCIM backfill script with 429 handling. 4) Maria to prepare communication for affected customers and open an ORC for RBAC backfill.
idp-bot: IdP metadata fetch at 2026-02-14T22:12:03Z returned 200; new signing key applied to 72% of nodes.
Maria L: If the IdP completes rollout, we should revert kid-fallback and reduce allow_clock_skew back to default. Keep the channel updated. :thumbsup:
Kevin P: I'm joining a call with the IdP in 5 to ask them to throttle SCIM sync bursts and confirm key convergence. Will post notes after the call.
Maria L: Thanks — let's aim to close the incident today if possible.
